reels.title: QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Video World Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: Fits the 'hardware_efficiency' category with a high audience multiplier (1.23x). The concept of 'KV cache quantization' is perfectly suited for a 3b1b-style visual breakdown showing memory buffers shrinking without losing vital information.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI's 'short-term memory' was so bloated it slowed down the entire internet?
